title: Use AGV API Controls to Remove/Recover an AGV and Pause/Resume All AGVs
summary: Use the System HMI API screen’s AGVs section to remove a problematic AGV by ID, recover (add back) the AGV by ID after physical recovery, and pause/resume all AGV movement fleet-wide.
when_to_use: When an AGV needs to be removed from the system (e.g., it has an issue) and later recovered after physical removal/recovery, and you need to pause/resume all AGV movement using the AGV API Controls.
not_for: Do not use this procedure as a substitute for required physical removal/recovery steps after using Remove AGV (the AGV must be physically removed; if it has a tote, the tote must be taken to the hospital where the tote is removed).
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Execute the AGV API Controls actions (Remove AGV, Recover AGV, Pause All AGVs, Resume All AGVs) and perform the required physical AGV/tote removal and recovery steps.
safety_notes: If the AGV has a tote, take the tote to the hospital where the tote is removed; the tote is recovered when it is put back in the system.
access_or_tools_needed: Hospital/onsite physical access to remove/recover the AGV and tote
System HMI API screen (AGVs section) with AGV API Controls

access_required: Access to the System HMI API screen with the AGVs section (AGV API Controls)
system_preconditions: You have the target AGV ID to enter into the Remove AGV and Recover AGV fields.

visual_references.description: AGV API Controls screen showing Remove AGV, Recover AGV, Pause All AGVs, Resume All AGVs (and related controls).
Get AGV Status pop-up used to view AGV details (battery status, command status, error codes, and AGV state).
Example HMI state for a faulted AGV with a tote; recovery guidance references removing the AGV via API controls and taking the tote to the hospital.

steps.title: Open the System HMI API screen and navigate to the AGVs section
steps.purpose: Access the AGV API Controls needed to remove/recover an AGV and pause/resume all AGV movement.
steps.instruction: Open the System HMI API screen and navigate to the AGVs section (AGV API Controls).
steps.expected_result: The AGVs section is visible with controls including Remove AGV, Recover AGV, Pause All AGVs, and Resume All AGVs.
steps.healthy_condition: AGV API Controls are visible and ready for input (Remove AGV / Recover AGV fields and Pause/Resume buttons are present).
steps.failure_condition: The AGVs section or required controls are not accessible/visible, preventing entry of an AGV ID or clicking Pause/Resume.

actions.label: Verify AGVs section controls are present
actions.exact_action: Navigate to the AGVs section of the API screen.

steps.title: Remove an AGV from the system by AGV ID
steps.purpose: Remove a problematic AGV from the system so it can be physically recovered.
steps.instruction: In the AGVs section, enter the target AGV ID in the Remove AGV input field, then click the Remove AGV control/button.
steps.expected_result: The Remove AGV action is accepted for the entered AGV ID, and the AGV is removed from the system after the required physical removal step.
steps.healthy_condition: After clicking Remove AGV, you can proceed with physical removal of the AGV from the system (and tote handling if applicable).
steps.failure_condition: You cannot physically remove the AGV/tote as required after issuing Remove AGV, or the system behavior does not match the expected fleet behavior after subsequent steps.

actions.label: Enter AGV ID and click Remove AGV
actions.exact_action: Enter the target AGV ID in the Remove AGV input field, then click the Remove AGV control/button.

actions.label: Physically remove AGV (and tote to hospital if present)
actions.exact_action: Physically remove the AGV from the system. If the AGV has a tote, take the tote to the hospital where the tote is removed.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if you cannot physically remove/recover the AGV/tote as required after using Remove AGV.

steps.title: Recover (add back) the AGV by AGV ID after physical recovery
steps.purpose: Add the physically recovered AGV back into the system.
steps.instruction: After the physical recovery/add-back step, enter the same (or correct) AGV ID in the Recover AGV input field, then click the Recover AGV control/button.
steps.expected_result: The Recover AGV action is accepted for the entered AGV ID, and the AGV is added back into the system after physical recovery.
steps.healthy_condition: The AGV is successfully re-added to the system and you can proceed to fleet pause/resume actions as needed.
steps.failure_condition: The AGV is not added back as expected after clicking Recover AGV (or you cannot complete the physical recovery/add-back step).

actions.label: Enter AGV ID and click Recover AGV
actions.exact_action: Enter the same (or correct) AGV ID in the Recover AGV input field, then click the Recover AGV control/button.

steps.title: Pause all AGV movement
steps.purpose: Stop fleet-wide AGV movement when needed during recovery/removal operations.
steps.instruction: Click Pause All AGVs in the AGVs section of the API screen.
steps.expected_result: Fleet-wide AGV movement is paused after clicking Pause All AGVs.
steps.healthy_condition: AGV movement is stopped fleet-wide (pause state is in effect).
steps.failure_condition: System does not reflect the expected fleet behavior after Pause All AGVs.
stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if the system does not reflect the expected fleet behavior after Pause All AGVs (use the Get AGV Status pop-up to verify AGV state).

steps.title: Resume all AGV movement
steps.purpose: Restart fleet-wide AGV movement after recovery/removal operations are complete.
steps.instruction: Click Resume All AGVs in the AGVs section of the API screen.
steps.expected_result: Fleet-wide AGV movement resumes after clicking Resume All AGVs.
steps.healthy_condition: AGV movement is running fleet-wide (resume state is in effect).
steps.failure_condition: System does not reflect the expected fleet behavior after Resume All AGVs.

success_criteria: Remove AGV is followed by physical removal of the AGV from the system; if a tote is present, the tote is taken to the hospital where the tote is removed.
Recover AGV is performed after physical recovery/add-back, resulting in the AGV being added back into the system.
Pause All AGVs stops fleet-wide AGV movement, and Resume All AGVs resumes fleet-wide AGV movement.
healthy_conditions: AGV API Controls actions complete and you can proceed with physical removal/recovery steps as required.
Fleet-wide AGV movement is paused after Pause All AGVs and resumes after Resume All AGVs.
failure_conditions: Cannot physically remove/recover the AGV/tote as required after using Remove AGV.
System does not reflect expected fleet behavior after Pause All AGVs (verify AGV state using Get AGV Status pop-up).
escalation_guidance: Stop and escalate if you cannot physically remove/recover the AGV/tote as required after using Remove AGV.
Stop and escalate if the system does not reflect expected fleet behavior after Pause All AGVs; verify AGV state using the Get AGV Status pop-up.
